summary: This House resolution supports designating the week of September 22 through September 26, 2025, as "National Hazing Awareness Week" to promote awareness and prevention of hazing.

scores.thoughts: This resolution supports designating a 'National Hazing Awareness Week' and discusses hazing prevention efforts, particularly on college campuses. While it doesn't directly address public school spending, it focuses on student safety and educational environments, making it tangentially related to the broader concept of education.
